source.source: Existing ordinary OPERATOR.md declarations only; no objects/header/image reads or new empirical storage measurements.

derived.dtype: float32 numerical payload only; headers/manifests/rosters and extraction overhead additional
derived.view_strategy: Authenticated immutable shared operator arrays with one isolated permitted view at a time; worker mount never exposes other folds. Exact memory/copy behavior requires implementation qualification.
derived.pass_read_caveat: Complete family preparation visits each eligible row in132 outer training memberships. This pass count is logical numerical payload, not source acquisition size or measured physical disk IO; OS caching, repeated passes and independent fits change actual IO.

reference.formula_shared_factor_lower: 2LDAfamilies*240*(5JOINT+5NUISANCE+1VISUAL)=5280, using exact leading-principal Cholesky factors forNEURAL andOCULAR
reference.formula_R0: 5040*27=136080 independent binary logistic optimizations, not common linear solves

retired_draft_grid.reason: Eight configurations times27 exhaustive inner folds was arbitrary mandatory tuning, not justified by the source's default-LDA scientific question.

reference.identity_reuse: Full derivation in REFERENCE_BANK.json and REFERENCE_ALGEBRA.md. Original session-exclusion policy prevents test-session training reuse. Cross-person visual equality remains unproven and is not counted.
reference.additional_model_tool_conditions: Reference fitted states/predictions may serve all selected modes only if their information policy, source/model identities and permitted inputs are exactly the same; provenance and costs remain attributed. Candidate model fits never silently reused.
reference.unique_work_bounds: 5040 distinct trusted reference views per fit family under the selected identity policy is fixed. LDA5280–10080 and PCA5040–7680 counts express qualified algebraic reuse versus separate-operation upper bounds. They do not assert runtime affordability.
reference.fallback_policy: Same scientific method: direct perlabel covariance solves when common-factor numerical parity fails; requires explicit future budget allowance, all failures/costs retained. No unbudgeted fallback, deletion or altered regularization.

independent_prediction_bank.fit_vs_output: State and probability-byte reuse never removes any30,000 logical destination or original inference/materialization/collection receipt.
independent_prediction_bank.NUM_NUM_REF_reuse: A single exact bank may serve both conditions; no extra fit multiplied merely by tool availability. Every condition still binds full support, and actual serving/mapping/copy/storage costs are additional.

reference.applies_when: P or I selected; all original full-core counts/methods unchanged. Inactive in D-only or standaloneR.

mode_counting: Canonical reference bank is fixed and reused only with proven identical model-tool information policy. Each selected candidate mode/tool/replicate still supplies all6000 artifacts. P/I/D/R experiments are separately declared scientific conditions, not a Cartesian product that must all be run to validate one prediction-program condition.
